verdict.rationale: Fellow's own pages offer only a vague accuracy claim ('human-level accuracy') and note that transcripts are diarized and timestamped. Nothing explains how transcription works or substantiates quality beyond that marketing phrase. missing for 10: named ASR models or providers, quantified accuracy metrics (e.g., WER) or benchmarks, documented known limits (languages, accents, audio conditions), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, the vendor documents how transcription actually works and its quality (models, accuracy claims, known limits) rather than just saying "AI-powered"

citations.quote: Fellow records, transcribes, and summarizes every meeting across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Slack huddles with enterprise-grade security and human-level accuracy.
